turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Hello, welcome. Can you start by telling me your age?

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: And are you currently married, single, or separated?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I'm single. I've been on my own for a while now.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Tell me about your health. Is there anything that makes daily life harder?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: My eyesight. I've had vision loss since 2019, and it's getting harder to read and to drive.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: I understand. What's your income at the moment?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I work part-time at a library, and I earn about sixteen thousand a year altogether.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Have you ever applied for the Disability Tax Credit?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: No, I never did. Nobody told me about it.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Do you have private dental insurance?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: No. I don't have any dental coverage at all.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: When did you last file your taxes?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: For last year, I think. I file every year, so it was for 2024.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Before we finish, is there anything you'd like to correct from earlier?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, going back to my income, sorry, it's actually seventeen thousand two hundred a year after a small raise.
